subject: Can't remove old subnet from our VPC
body: I'm trying to clean up a subnet in our VPC that we don't use anymore. I select it in the VPC console and hit delete, but it just errors out saying there are still dependencies, and I can't figure out what's holding it. I already stopped the instance that was in there, but it still won't go away.

subject: Instances in one subnet aren't getting public IPs
body: We spun up a few EC2 instances in a subnet we created ourselves, and none of them can reach the internet or get a public address, even though instances in our default subnet work fine. I checked the subnet settings but I'm not sure what to change. Can you help me make new instances in this subnet automatically get a public address?

subject: Charged for an IP address I'm not even using
body: I set up a static public IP for a demo instance a few weeks ago and then terminated the instance, but I'm still seeing a charge on my bill for it every month. I thought it would just go away when I got rid of the server. Can someone tell me how to stop paying for this thing? I don't see any running instances attached to it anymore.

subject: Old NAT box in public subnet can't keep up, want to replace it
body: We've been running our own NAT server on an EC2 instance for a while and it keeps falling over under load — someone has to babysit it and patch it, and failover is a manual script. I'd like to move to something AWS manages so I don't have to think about it, but I want to keep the same public IP our partners have whitelisted. What's the least disruptive way to swap it out, and will existing connections drop when I do?

subject: Can't find any traffic or error stats for our NAT gateway
body: I want to keep an eye on our NAT gateway but I can't find any numbers for it anywhere in the console. I'd like to see how much data is flowing through it, how many connections are active, and whether it's throwing errors, ideally updated frequently and going back far enough that I can compare this month to earlier months. Where do I go to pull that up?

subject: Can't create VPC or subnet — access denied in console
body: I'm trying to set up a new VPC with a public subnet for a project, but every time I try to create the VPC, subnet, or internet gateway in the AWS console I get an Access Denied error saying I'm not authorized to perform ec2:CreateVpc. I'm using an IAM role that was set up for me, and I can view the existing VPC resources just fine, but I can't create or change anything. Can someone give my role the permissions it needs to build out the VPC and route tables?

subject: WorkSpaces can't reach the internet to install updates
body: My WorkSpace keeps failing when I try to run OS updates and install apps - it just times out with connection errors. Nothing on it can get out to the web at all. I'm not sure if it's a network setting on our side or something with how the WorkSpace was set up, but I need it to be able to download things.

subject: Need to limit WorkSpaces access to office network only
body: Right now anyone can log into their WorkSpaces from home or a coffee shop, and our security team wants to restrict access so people can only connect from our office network and our VPN. I have the list of public IP ranges we want to allow. How do I set this up so only those addresses work?

subject: WorkSpaces won't launch - can't pick my subnets
body: I'm trying to set up WorkSpaces for a few new hires but when I get to the part where I choose where they should live, the subnets I already created in our AWS account aren't showing up as options. I made two subnets in the same zone, and I'm not sure if that's the problem or if I set up the networking wrong. I just need internet access to work on these machines without making everything publicly exposed.

subject: Can't get into my desktop from my new Chromebook
body: I just switched to a Chromebook and I can't figure out how to get to my work desktop anymore. On my old laptop I just went to a website and logged in, but that doesn't seem to work here. Is there an app I need to install, and where do I download it?

subject: Users on Windows client seeing a restart prompt and a different interface after an update
body: A bunch of our people got the latest Windows WorkSpaces client and now when they pick their desktop they get asked to restart into some new-looking app, and some have ended up in it without meaning to. We're not ready for that yet and want everyone staying on the same familiar interface until we say otherwise, with no way for them to flip it themselves. Can this be set once for the whole directory instead of me going desk to desk?

subject: Need to duplicate our WorkSpaces image into another region
body: We built a golden image in our main region and now the team in Europe wants to spin up WorkSpaces from the exact same setup. I tried the Images section in the console but I don't see any obvious way to get that image over there. Can you help me make a copy in the other region, and do I need any special permissions to do it?

subject: Need to set up networking so my WorkSpaces Pools can reach the internet
body: I'm rolling out WorkSpaces Pools and I need to build out the network side from scratch. I don't have anything set up yet — no VPC with separate public and private pieces, and I'm not sure how to get the private instances talking to the outside world. Can you walk me through creating the whole setup, including whatever's needed so my users can get to their home folders and app settings?

subject: Can't change encryption settings for my WorkSpace's remote session
body: I want to force my WorkSpace connections to use the strongest encryption available and turn off the weaker default. When I looked through the console I couldn't find any option to change how the streaming session is encrypted, and I'm not sure where to even set this. How do I change the encryption settings for the remote session on my WorkSpace?

subject: Call audio sounds robotic and choppy in WorkSpaces
body: Our contact center agents work out of their WorkSpaces and the call audio is awful - it's delayed and garbled, and customers keep saying they can't understand us. This worked fine when everyone was on regular desktops, so something about running it inside the virtual desktop seems to be the problem. Can we make the calls sound normal again without moving everyone off WorkSpaces?

subject: Need to give new hires their own WorkSpaces logins, no directory exists yet
body: We're onboarding a few new hires next week and want to hand each of them a WorkSpace they sign into with their own username and password, but right now there's nothing in our AWS account that holds user accounts at all. When I try to create a directory from the WorkSpaces console I get stuck partway through and don't understand what I'm being asked for or how the users get added once it's done. Can someone help me get the directory side of this stood up so we can actually create the WorkSpaces?

subject: Can't get WorkSpaces set up — no directory to pick
body: I'm trying to roll out virtual desktops for our team but the setup wizard won't let me continue because there's no directory in the dropdown. I don't have anything in Directory Service yet and I'm not sure which kind I'm supposed to make — we have our own Active Directory on-prem but I'd rather not overcomplicate things. What do I need to create first so the desktops can actually work?

subject: Users can't install software on their WorkSpaces
body: Several people on my team are getting prompted for admin credentials every time they try to install anything on their WorkSpaces, and some settings are greyed out. I need them to be able to install their own apps without IT having to remote in each time. Is there a way to turn this on for the whole group at once?

subject: Copied text won't paste into my Linux WorkSpace
body: I'm on one of the Ubuntu WorkSpaces and when I copy something on my laptop and try to paste it inside the WorkSpace, nothing shows up. Copying from the WorkSpace out to my laptop works fine, it's only the other direction that's broken. I haven't changed any settings, it just started doing this. Can someone check what's going on?

subject: Need to switch my Linux WorkSpace to a different distro without losing my files
body: I'd like to move my Linux WorkSpace from the current OS to a different Linux distribution. I have a lot of files in my home folder that I can't lose, and I'm worried about whether they'll survive the switch. Can you help me figure out the right way to do this and what I need to check before starting?

subject: Can't change pool to AlwaysOn — option is greyed out
body: I'm trying to switch one of our WorkSpaces Pools from the auto-stop behavior to always running, but when I go into the console and pick the pool, the option to change it is unavailable. I found the Actions menu but the choice is greyed out and nothing happens when I click it. Do I need to do something to the pool first before I can change this setting?

subject: Users lose their files every time they log into the pool
body: Our team uses the pooled desktops and every time someone disconnects and comes back, anything they saved to their desktop or documents is gone. I need their files to stick around between sessions, and I also need to know where those files actually live so I can set up our apps to save there. Can you tell me how to turn this on for our existing directory?

subject: Can't find where to set up a shared desktop pool for our team
body: I need to get a shared desktop setup going for our contractors so they can each launch an app session without me assigning them individual machines. I poked around the WorkSpaces console but I only see options for single desktops, and I'm not sure what to pick for the billing mode or how long sessions should stay alive before timing out. Can you point me to the right place and walk me through the settings?

subject: Sharing our custom WorkSpaces image with a sister account
body: We built a custom image in our AWS account for our WorkSpaces, and another team in our organization wants to use the same image so their users get the identical desktop setup. I can't find where in the WorkSpaces console I'd make our image available to their account, or what they'd need to do afterward to actually launch from it. Can you walk me through it?

subject: Need to label our WorkSpaces so finance can split costs by team
body: We have about 40 virtual desktops and finance keeps asking me to break down the monthly bill by department, but right now everything just shows up as one lump cost. I want to attach something like a team name or project code to each desktop so the charges can be grouped, but I can't figure out where to do that in the console or whether it will even show up in the billing reports. Also, if I set this up partway through the month, will the past charges get sorted too, or does it only start counting from when I add it?

subject: Audio in our web app is laggy and uses the wrong mic inside WorkSpaces
body: We run a browser-based calling app, and when our staff use it from inside their WorkSpaces desktops the audio is choppy and delayed, and it seems to be picking up the remote machine's audio devices instead of their local headset. In a normal browser outside WorkSpaces it sounds fine, so it looks like the app isn't taking advantage of the local device setup that's available in that environment. Can you point me at what a developer needs to change in the app so it uses the user's local mic and speakers?

subject: WorkSpaces client won't connect from our office network
body: Ever since our office switched to the new firewall, I can't get into my WorkSpaces desktop from the office — the client just spins and eventually times out. It works fine from my home Wi-Fi, so I'm guessing the corporate network is blocking something. Our security team wants a list of exactly which ports and destinations need to be allowed through so they can add an exception.

subject: Console won't let me edit a user or resend their invite
body: I'm trying to update one of our existing WorkSpaces users in the console and send them a new invitation email, but the page just spins and then throws an access denied message. I can see the user listed fine, so I don't understand why changing their details is blocked. There's a similar failure when I try to pick a different OU for new WorkSpaces during setup.

subject: Our virtual desktop setup is going away - what do we do?
body: I run the team that manages our cloud desktops for the call center staff, and I just heard that the service we've been using for this is being discontinued at the end of 2027. We have custom images we built over the years and about 200 people who log in every day, so I need to figure out how to move everyone somewhere else without a big disruption. Can someone walk me through what our options are and how to get our images over to a replacement platform?

subject: Zero client won't connect to my WorkSpace
body: I'm trying to use the small zero client box at my desk instead of the desktop app, but it never gets me into my WorkSpace. I put in the code from my welcome email and it just spins or errors out. Does this device need a firmware update or something enabled on your end before it will work?

subject: Need to use my headset for calls in the remote desktop tool
body: I work in the contact center and take customer calls through the tool that runs inside my remote desktop session. Right now the sound comes through my laptop speakers and my USB headset doesn't seem to be picked up at all, so customers say I sound far away and I get an echo. My admin mentioned there's some audio setup for the remote desktop that makes headsets work properly, but I don't know what I need installed or what to open to turn it on.

subject: Webcam not detected inside my WorkSpace
body: I'm on a Windows laptop and my WorkSpace is DCV, but when I join video calls the camera never shows up — the app just says no camera found. The webcam works fine in other apps on my laptop. I don't see any option in the client to share it with the remote desktop. How do I get it to show up in my WorkSpace?

subject: Can't finish setting up my new remote desktop account
body: I got an email saying my account was created and I need to finish setting it up, but I kept putting it off.
